Name: Extended Qi Gem and Golden Walnut Display
Author: Spiderbuttons
Description:
All this mod does is tweak the little bit of UI that pops up whenever you pick up or are spending your Qi Gems or Golden Walnuts. Previously, if you had more than 999 of either of them, the display would not function properly as it could only support 3 digits. Now, you can display up to 10 digits, in case you really like collecting Qi Gems or Golden Walnuts (or another mod gives you so many that it breaks the display.)

[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Extract the mod into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
